name: robots/simpler-env__maniskill2_real2sim
title: SimplerEnv ManiSkill2 real2sim (GraspSingleCokeCanInScene-v0)
intro: SimplerEnv ManiSkill2 real2sim (GraspSingleCokeCanInScene-v0), adapted from simpler-env/maniskill2_real2sim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 5 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
